appDescription.message: Export rendered X bookmark cards to JSON, CSV, or Markdown without API keys or a backend.

intro.message: Reads bookmark cards from the open X bookmarks page. It does not collect passwords, cookies, or session tokens.

privacyText.message: Privacy: Data is processed only in the active tab and downloaded directly to your device. No backend is used.

openBookmarksError.message: Open x.com/i/history/bookmarks/ first, then try again.

startedStatus.message: Export started. Keep the tab open; progress appears in the lower-right corner.

keepOpen.message: Keep this tab open. Data is processed only in this tab.

stopping.message: Stopping. Collected records will be written to a file...

scanProgress.message: Scan pass $CYCLE$. Passes with no new records: $IDLE$.

noBookmarksFound.message: No bookmark cards were found. Wait for the page to load, then try again.

downloadComplete.message: $COUNT$ records were saved to your Downloads folder.
